evolutionary_takeaways: Parallel agent isolation requires 3 independent variables per agent: (1) unique Chrome --user-data-dir, (2) unique --remote-debugging-port, (3) unique candidate_config.json cdp_url pointing to that port.
Port assignment convention for this workspace: 9222 = Anshika Garg, 9223 = Udaysagar Kandpal. Any new profile gets the next sequential port.
The only config change needed to redirect an agent to a new Chrome session is cdp_url in candidate_config.json. No Python script changes ever.
Win+R command format for Chrome parallel session: chrome.exe --remote-debugging-port=<PORT> --user-data-dir="C:\chrome-dev-session-<N>"
Each agent's IPC file is profile-namespaced: profiles/<name>/output/pending_question.json — zero crossover risk.
User thinks at systems-architecture level: isolate at OS boundary first, then config, then code. This is the correct order.
